jurisdiction: India - Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA)

drone_categories.operating_rules: Permitted up to 50 feet (15m) AGL in Green Zones. No pilot certificate needed for non-commercial operations.
Permitted up to 200 feet (60m) AGL in Green Zones. Requires UIN registration on DigitalSky and Remote Pilot Certificate (RPC) for commercial use.
Permitted up to 400 feet (120m) AGL in Green Zones. Requires UIN, RPC from DGCA-approved RPTO, maintenance logbook, and mandatory insurance.
Requires special clearance, operator permit, and strict adherence to designated air corridors. Mainly used for heavy agricultural spraying and cargo logistics.
Governed under Aircraft Rules 1937 and specialized DGCA experimental/military operational approvals.

airspace_zones.description: Airspace up to 400 ft (120 m) not designated as yellow or red zone. Located beyond 8 km from perimeter of an operational airport.
airspace_zones.permission_needed: No prior flight permission required on DigitalSky. Just log flight plan before takeoff.

airspace_zones.description: Controlled airspace up to 400 ft located within 8-12 km from airport perimeter, or above 400 ft in green zones.
airspace_zones.permission_needed: Prior flight permission mandatory via Air Traffic Control (ATC) on DigitalSky platform.

airspace_zones.description: No-fly zone near international borders, military bases, Rashtrapati Bhavan, nuclear plants, and within 5 km of international airport perimeter.
airspace_zones.permission_needed: Strictly prohibited without explicit Central Government clearance.

penalties_and_fines.violation: Flying in Red Zone without authorization
penalties_and_fines.legal_action: Confiscation of drone, revocation of RPC, potential prosecution under IPC/Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.
Grounding of aircraft and fine under Rule 49 of Drone Rules 2021.

penalties_and_fines.violation: Commercial operation without Remote Pilot Certificate (RPC)
penalties_and_fines.legal_action: Fine on operator and remote pilot.

penalties_and_fines.violation: Non-compliance with NPNT (No Permission No Take-off) module
penalties_and_fines.legal_action: Suspension of type certificate for manufacturer and fine on operator.

certification_and_imports.type_certificate: Issued by DGCA based on Quality Council of India (QCI) evaluation.
certification_and_imports.import_policy: Import of completely built-in (CBU) drones banned since Feb 2022 to promote Make in India, except for defense and R&D. Import of drone components is allowed.
certification_and_imports.rpto_rules: Remote Pilot Training Organizations must be DGCA authorized. License valid for 10 years for candidates aged 18-65 who passed Class 10.
